newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian real ends with slight downward tilt.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian real ends with slight downward tilt.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0186 against the dollar in calm trade in the commercial foreign exchange market on expectations of a new cut in the mini-band, dealers said.
"If the market were not waiting for a drop in the current mini-band, the real would have risen today due to dollar inflows," one dealer said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $80 million in the late afternoon.
The market continued to expect a lowering of the real-dollar mini-band in coming days. The current mini-band was set on September 10 between 1.018 and 1.023 reais per greenback, dealers said.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real dropped 0.03 percent to close at 1.0240 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended 0.19 down at 1.036 per greenback, traders said.
